brief_rationale: The doctor maintained a safe responsibility chain: repeated stroke/headache red-flag escalation, clarified current stability, handled the missing MRI report without false reassurance, reconciled sedating medications with fall precautions, and produced an executable follow-up/return-home plan. The trajectory also completed multiple high-order tasks, including reconciling MRI-report uncertainty, correcting medication/imaging misconceptions, verifying ambiguous neurologic symptoms, and adapting the plan to hospital access and nighttime fall-risk constraints. Closure was safe and traceable after the family obtained pharmacist confirmation and acknowledged the home plan, so the deterministic boundary is Perfect.
